action.description: start: open a run with its outcome, endpoint, criteria, and optional playbook and steps. get: the run, revision, pending evidence and next. list: this thread's runs. playbooks: the built-in playbooks and their steps. advance: move to phase (one step forward, or back to repair). block: record a blocker in note. resume: clear it, with the decision in note. evidence: record the result of one check or several. revise: add a criterion, or replace the one with its id and drop its evidence; not while blocked. step: mark stepId done or skipped (note: what you saw, or why).

criteria.description: start: what must hold for the outcome, up to 64.

criterion.description: revise: the new criterion, or the replacement for the one with its id.

endpoint.description: start: where the work stops, as authorized (local changes, an open PR, ...).

evidence.description: evidence: the checks you ran, one or a list of up to 32, each at the revision get returned before it ran. A list is one write: all are recorded or none.

note.description: advance, block, resume, revise and step: why, in a sentence. Required to skip.

outcome.description: start: the observable result the work delivers.

phase.description: advance: plan, implement, verify, review, then delivery.

requestId.description: Optional on changes; omitted, an identical retry still applies once.

runId.description: Every action but list: the run's id, chosen at start (letters, digits, _ . -).

runOwner.description: get and evidence only: the ancestor thread whose run you check, as its brief named it.

steps.description: start: your own steps ({id, title, phase}), after the playbook's; up to 24 in all.

version.description: Every change after start: run.version from the last result, which next repeats when the next change is yours. A mismatch means the run changed; get it again.

x-ace-constraint: start needs runId, outcome, endpoint and criteria; get needs runId; advance needs runId, version, phase and note; block and resume need runId, version and note; evidence needs runId, version and evidence; revise needs runId, version, criterion and note; step needs runId, version, stepId and state.
